notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 partial attribute ownership-transfer surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, multi-attribute FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies cancellation of one pending acquisition followed by Divestiture If Wanted for the remaining attribute, ownership state, standard callbacks, and resignation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador partial attribute acquisition, cancellation, Divestiture If Wanted, ownership query, and resignation services with FederateAmbassador ownership callbacks
